rounds.ai_message: Hello, this is Tom from Jiangnan Knitting Mill. You sent us an inquiry for jersey fabric yesterday. What can I do for you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 你好,我是江南针织厂的 Tom。你昨天发了一份汗布的询价,请问有什么可以帮您?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍并说明来意:需要找特定规格的针织布
rounds.common_mistakes: inquiry / enquiry 都对,口语里常直接说 inquiry。
rounds.tips_zh: 询针织布时要先讲:产品类型(单面/双面/罗纹)、克重、成分、用途。
rounds.user_response_example: Hello Tom, this is Chen Wei from Lily Garments. I am looking for single jersey fabric for our men's T-shirt line.

rounds.ai_message: Good. What GSM are you looking at, and what is the composition?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。你们要多少克重的?成分是什么?
rounds.common_mistakes: GSM(grams per square meter)不要按字面说 grams per square meter 全文,口语里直接说 GSM 即可。
rounds.tips_zh: 男 T 恤常用 180-220 GSM,女 T 恤 140-180 GSM。
rounds.user_response_example: We need around 180 GSM, 100% combed cotton, single jersey.

rounds.ai_message: 180 GSM combed cotton, single jersey — standard. What about width? Do you need tubular or open width?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 180 克精梳棉单面汗布,常规的。门幅呢?要圆筒还是开幅?
rounds.common_mistakes: tubular(圆筒) 和 open width(开幅) 是针织布的两种卷装方式,选哪种看后整理和裁剪习惯。
rounds.tips_zh: 圆筒布(tubular)是圆筒状,适合 T 恤套裁;开幅布(open width)是平幅,适合大身裁片。
rounds.user_response_example: Tubular is fine for us, around 180 cm circumference.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Tubular 180 cm, 180 GSM combed cotton, we can do that. What about the yarn count — 26s or 32s?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。圆筒 180cm,180 克精梳棉,能做。纱支用 26 支还是 32 支?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 选择纱支,讨论手感和成本
rounds.common_mistakes: yarn count 26s = 26 英支(英制),数字越大纱越细,布越薄越贵。
rounds.tips_zh: 26s 偏厚实耐穿(适合 200+ GSM),32s 偏细腻(适合 150-180 GSM)。
rounds.user_response_example: 26s is fine. 32s would be a bit too fine for this style, and more expensive.

rounds.ai_message: Good. About the quantity — we usually run at least 1,000 kg per color. How much do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。数量方面,我们一般每个色至少 1 吨。你们需要多少?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明下单量,确认起订量
rounds.common_mistakes: 针织布的 MOQ 通常以 kg 计,而不是成衣的件(pieces)。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织染整厂起染量一般 500-1000 kg/色,小批量要加价。
rounds.user_response_example: We have 3 colors this season. Each color is about 1,500 kg, total 4,500 kg.

rounds.ai_message: 4,500 kg clears the MOQ easily. I can offer around US$3.20 per kg for 26s combed cotton, 180 GSM, tubular, dyed. Lead time is 25 days after lab dip approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 4.5 吨轻松过起订量。26 支精梳棉 180 克圆筒染色,3.2 美元/公斤。批准色样后 25 天出货。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认价格和交期,问样品
rounds.common_mistakes: lab dip 是染厂对色样,针织厂跟染厂是 separate workflow,先打 lab dip 才能进染缸。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织厂通常跟染厂分工:针织厂管坯布,染厂管染色/印花,交期要算两段。
rounds.user_response_example: Lead time is fine. Can you send me lab dips first? I need 3 Pantone TCX colors signed off before bulk.

rounds.ai_message: Sure. We can send lab dips in 5 days. Once you approve them, knitting starts in 7 days, dyeing another 10, total about 22 days. About shrinkage — what tolerance can you accept?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以。5 天可以出对色样。批准后,针织 7 天,染色 10 天,总共 22 天左右。缩水方面,你们能接受多少公差?
rounds.common_mistakes: shrinkage 缩水说'5%以内',一般指 length × width 都达标,行业用 lengthwise / widthwise 分别报。
rounds.tips_zh: 棉针织缩水行业标准 ±5%,pre-shrunk(预缩)可压到 ±3%。
rounds.user_response_example: Within 5% lengthwise and widthwise is acceptable. If you can do pre-shrunk finishing, even better.

rounds.ai_message: We do compact pre-shrinking — that gets it to about 3%. I'll include that in the offer. Send me the Pantone numbers, and I'll have the lab dips ready by Friday. Anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我们做紧式预缩,能压到 3% 左右。报价里会包含。把潘通号发我,周五前出对色样。还有别的吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 发送潘通号,确认收件邮箱,收尾
rounds.common_mistakes: pre-shrunk 工艺要写明 finishing 里,不能口头说;PI 里要单独列。
rounds.tips_zh: pre-shrunk 工艺(预缩)在 PI 的 finishing 栏单独列,后续 QC 才好对照。
rounds.user_response_example: I'll send the 3 Pantone TCX numbers by email this afternoon. Looking forward to the lab dips. Thanks, Tom.
